text:
**Sunday**: tutoring this afternoon. Bring the one thing from last week that never quite clicked; that is exactly what the time is for.

The week ahead is busy after school: ASL Club on **Monday**, tutoring again on **Wednesday**, Crochet Club on **Friday**, and Tae Kwon Do in between. It is gear week there, so arrive already suited up.

Monday and Friday are your evenings without Tae Kwon Do, which makes them the ones for getting ahead. Your Biology shelf has a Meiosis lesson, and one round of it before class gets far makes the next few periods feel like review instead of news.
